features.title: Find your way around
features.description: Use the tabs to reach Armed, Vault, Community, Support and Settings.

features.title: Safeword protection
features.description: Choose your trigger phrase and enable recognition while the app is open in the foreground. Offline recognition depends on your device.

features.title: Record and alert
features.description: Hold the alert control for two seconds to record audio. Configured trusted contacts can receive one SMS when permission is granted. Stop and seal encrypts the evidence on this device.

features.title: Trusted contacts
features.description: Add the people you want to alert in Settings. Emergency SMS goes only to configured contacts when SMS permission is granted.

features.title: Encrypted evidence vault
features.description: Evidence is encrypted on this device. Authenticate with your device security to view recordings or export a chain-of-custody record. No cloud or peer sync is connected.

features.title: Photo and video evidence
features.description: Capture a private photo or a silent video up to 60 seconds, or import an image or video. Each item is encrypted and added to the evidence chain.

features.title: Community map
features.description: Explore sample danger zones and route previews. These are not live safety reports or a safety guarantee. Map tiles need internet access; check local conditions.

features.title: Support resources
features.description: Find public support resources and official links here. Phone actions open your dialer so you remain in control.

features.title: Decoy call
features.description: Show a simulated incoming-call screen now or after a delay. It rings locally but does not place a real call or play a voice conversation.

features.title: Notes disguise
features.description: Disguise changes the launcher and opens All Notes on future launches. To return to VAANI, hold the %1$s header for two seconds, or enter ##, vaani, or 911 in the Notes search field. Lock to Notes hides the safety interface immediately.

features.title: Replay the walkthrough
features.description: Return to Help & onboarding in Settings to replay this tour anytime. Feature help also lets you review individual explanations.

features.title: Deliberate shake wake
features.description: In Gesture-Wake mode, a deliberate back-and-forth shake opens a listening window for up to 12 seconds. Ordinary handling should not wake it. Gesture detection works only while VAANI or Notes is open in the foreground.

features.title: Location protection
features.description: Track while armed keeps a timestamped last known location ready for emergency SMS. Android shows an ongoing notification while tracking is active.

features.title: Device and vault security
features.description: The vault uses your fingerprint, face, or device screen lock and locks when the app leaves the foreground. Set up device security to access sealed evidence.

features.title: Emergency dispatch
features.description: Trusted-contact SMS works when configured and permitted. Police, NGO, peer and shelter panels are previews until an approved integration is connected.

features.title: Verify chain integrity
features.description: After unlocking the vault, verify the hashes of sealed evidence and its chain. Verification flags mismatches; it does not prove that a recording describes a real event.

features.title: Blackout display
features.description: Blackout covers the vault with a dark screen. Use Return to vault to leave it. It does not stop an ongoing recording.
